author: Smith, S. A.
title: Russia in Revolution: An Empire in Crisis, 1890 to 1928
notes: The post-revisionist synthesis, and the one that keeps the empire in view: 1917 as the middle of a crisis running from the 1890s to the end of the 1920s, with the nationalities, the peasantry and the war economy given the weight the Petrograd-centred accounts cannot give them. Use it for the empire-wide frame and for what the revolution looked like outside the capital. Borrow-only; cited without pages.
